These companion effects execute later through separate all-player loops.

facts.value: Canonical source declares db_MiscVisualEffectsStatus as a writable signed C int with static storage duration and implicit zero initialization. Starting from that initialized state, this handler cycles the selector through 0, 1, 2, 3 and back to 0. The sole post-increment >3 check is not general normalization of arbitrary signed values. Exact compiled .sbss membership, symbol extent, and the meaning of additional bytes in existing artifacts remain unresolved.
facts.rationale: Remove the unsupported target-padding interpretation identified by independent review. Retain only the source declaration, initialization and normal-state transitions; defer compiled layout.

evidence.why: Declares the signed selector and implements its guarded increment, upper-bound reset and HUD state changes; does not establish compiled section layout.

facts.value: Acts per invocation, not once per frame. It tests stored X-held and down-pressed masks without consuming them, increments the shared signed selector, resets it only if the result is >3, then clears the HUD-hidden flag for0 or sets it for nonzero when needed. No chord means no local writes or HUD reconciliation. The four-slot caller permits several advances in one frame; during Hand-boss presence slots2-3 are unrefreshed but still dispatched, so a retained qualifying mask can retrigger on later frames. There is no local DbLevel or index guard.

facts.value: One shared selector is advanced separately for each qualifying controller invocation. Normally it cycles0-1-2-3-0; the signed implementation checks only the post-increment upper bound. Mode0 shows the HUD by clearing its hidden flag; nonzero hides it if not already hidden. No-input calls do not reconcile unrelated HUD changes. dbinit executes all four visual handlers before camera/background and stage handlers, so several simultaneous inputs select a final shared mode before those later consumers run; stale unrefreshed Hand-boss slots can repeat old input.
